correctness.rationale: For the repaired finding only. The frozen Finding's eighth power is false: it is 3ω²+2, as in the later proof. More materially, the frozen tuple sums to 2b and so is not in the ideal of (x−1)(x−α) for b≠0; its verifier enumerates that tuple without testing cyclic-code membership. The repair derives the actual coefficients of ag+bxg, and identifies an invertible base-field coordinate map taking the printed tuple to them, which explains why the frozen counts survive. The quartic forces order 32 and ord_32(7)=4 proves irreducibility. α²=−1 implies F_7(α)=F_49. For affine t the span is that of 1,tα,t−α: rank ≤2 iff t∈F_49, rank 1 iff t=α, and infinity has rank 2. A rank-three line and the base-field zero-sum hyperplane give M_2=3 by Frobenius closure. The separately written repairs/3/artifacts/verify.py replayed all 2402 points from g,xg, tested both roots on each representative, and gave (1,49,2352), with the expected ordinary counts. The repaired publication files and unchanged verification JSON front matter were inspected; no external attestation or formal verification is claimed.
